h:
这是一个非官方 ComfyUI 节点使用以下命令为无声视频添加声音腾讯混源视频Foley模型.
你放入一个安静的剪辑，给它一个小小的提示，比如“海洋之声”或“燃烧的树”，它会生成与图像同步的音频——波浪随着水的起伏而起伏，火焰随着火焰的节奏而噼啪作响，暴风雨镜头下的雷声滚滚，甚至在合适的时候播放轻快的背景音乐。

信用：https://aistudynow.com/hunyuanvideo-foley-comfyui-workflow-turn-quiet-video-into-sound/

https://github.com/aistudynow/Comfyui-HunyuanFoley

o.en:
This is anunofficial ComfyUI nodethat adds sound to silent video usingTencent’s HunyuanVideo Foley model.
You drop in a quiet clip, give it a tiny prompt like“ocean sound”or“burning tree”, and it generates audio that syncs to the picture — waves rise and fade with water, fire crackles in rhythm with flames, thunder rolls under storm shots, even light background music when it fits.

Credit:https://aistudynow.com/hunyuanvideo-foley-comfyui-workflow-turn-quiet-video-into-sound/

https://github.com/aistudynow/Comfyui-HunyuanFoley
